This Ancient Carving Shows a Device No One Can Identify

An ancient Egyptian carving reveals a fascinating object that raises many questions. 

The figure appears to be holding or presenting a device with a circular design, intricate details, and a tall structure extending from its center. Its unusual shape makes it difficult to determine what it was meant to represent. 

Was it a ceremonial object, a symbolic instrument, or something entirely different? 

What do you think this mysterious object represents?
.
.
.
#ancient #mystery #ancientcivilizations #ancientsecrets
